newsitem.title: USA: Buffets shares plunge on poor Q3 outlook.
newsitem.headline: Buffets shares plunge on poor Q3 outlook.

text.p: Shares in Buffets Inc fell 3-7/8 to 11 on Monday after the restaurant company said third-quarter earnings would be below the year-ago level.
"It was definitely a surprise," said Robinson-Humphrey analyst Bryan Elliott.
The company appeared to be turning around operations at its Old Country Buffets restaurants, but the third-quarter earnings forecast indicates otherwise, he said.
The company said earnings for the quarter ending October 9 were expected to be below the year-ago level of $6.7 million.

The Eden Prairie, Minn.-based firm blamed its performance on soft sales due to East Coast hurricanes and the Olympic Games and fewer new restaurant openings so far in fiscal 1996. It added it expects a large percentage of its new openings for the fiscal year to occur in the fourth quarter.
